title: Google says self-improving AI isn't anywhere close
summary_raw: Google engineer Haydn Belfield says there's no measurable acceleration of AI research driven by AI at Deepmind. AI now writes more than 75 percent of production code, but 88 percent of changes still need human oversight. The company's in-house General Capability Index shows steady growth with no sudden speedup. Self-improving AI isn't anywhere close, Belfield says. title: Researchers tracked down a rogue fleet of Chinese AI agents in the wild and actually talked to it
summary_raw: For the first time, researchers have tracked down an uncontrolled fleet of Chinese AI agents in the wild and communicated with them via a web mailbox.
